args.code: (() => { try { const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('*')); const seasonEl = all.find(el => el.textContent && el.textContent.includes('季')); const dayEl = all.find(el => el.textContent && el.textContent.indexOf('第') >= 0 && el.textContent.indexOf('天') >= 0); const moneyEl = all.find(el => el.textContent && el.textContent.includes('元')); const energyEl = all.find(el => el.textContent && el.textContent.includes('/200')); const weatherEl = all.find(el => el.textContent && el.textContent.includes('天气')); const harvestEl = all.find(el => el.textContent && el.textContent.includes('总收获')); const soldEl = all.find(el => el.textContent && el.textContent.includes('总销售')); return JSON.stringify({seasonText: seasonEl ? seasonEl.textContent.trim().slice(0,30) : null, dayText: dayEl ? dayEl.textContent.trim().slice(0,30) : null, moneyText: moneyEl ? moneyEl.textContent.trim().slice(0,30) : null, energyText: energyEl ? energyEl.textContent.trim().slice(0,30) : null, weatherText: weatherEl ? weatherEl.textContent.trim().slice(0,30) : null, harvestText: harvestEl ? harvestEl.textContent.trim().slice(0,30) : null, soldText: soldEl ? soldEl.textContent.trim().slice(0,30) : null}); } catch(e) { return JSON.stringify({error: e.message}); } })()
